author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Family disaster connections, archive struggle, reforms and psychedelic coda

scenes.title: The label sounds reasonable
scenes.viewerPurpose: Notice that a reasonable explanation can leave a loss Meet the curator and what labels leave out
scenes.composition: Mara examines a brass lamp and its neat label
addOrChange: Remove animated oil and add an omitted person’s note beside the label.

cues.narration: The explanation is reasonable, but someone has still lost something.
cues.visualAction: The polished label stands beside a missing ownership detail.

cues.narration: The Museum of Good Reasons follows Mara, a curator learning to read what museum labels leave out.
cues.visualAction: Mara leans toward the detail the label did not include.

scenes.title: Mara’s first objection
scenes.viewerPurpose: See an ordinary lamp opening a difficult inquiry Notice a gift becoming an unwanted claim
scenes.composition: Two people share an umbrella but expect different routes
addOrChange: Carry the lamp briefly into the transition and simplify street geometry.

cues.narration: An ordinary lamp draws her into a world of gifts, borrowed time, and disputed care.
cues.visualAction: Move from the lamp to the umbrella’s ordinary story.

cues.narration: Here, a kind intention can live beside a claim nobody agreed to.
cues.visualAction: One person starts walking while the other pauses before following.

scenes.title: Care with a hidden claim
scenes.viewerPurpose: Hear that both sides have reasons Want more than an easy expose of a lie
scenes.composition: A moved bench sits beside two defensible accounts
addOrChange: Remove detailed hauling choreography, measured distance and extra documents.

cues.narration: The people defending each exhibit have reasons worth hearing.
cues.visualAction: Place complaint and official reply beside the same bench.

cues.narration: That makes Mara’s task harder than exposing a convenient lie.
cues.visualAction: Mara’s pencil pauses without crossing either account out.

scenes.title: Look beside the label
scenes.viewerPurpose: Find familiar stories inside museum objects Want to look for the person missing from a label
scenes.composition: A reader opens the novel beside the lamp image
addOrChange: Remove duplicate headings and elaborate page-turn mechanics.

cues.narration: This philosophical novel turns familiar objects into unsettling questions about the stories we accept.
cues.visualAction: The reader compares a familiar object with its recorded story.

cues.narration: Step inside, and notice who disappears when a museum label tells only the easy part.
cues.visualAction: Bring the omitted person back beside the easy museum label.
